environment.credential_check: NO lab .env, no THETA* OS environment variables, no home config; auth_mode() raises. Acquisition branch blocked pending user-supplied credentials (see verification report).

baseline_specs.field: inherited point-in-time common-stock/ETP-exclusion field; prior close $10-$80; prior-day dollar volume >= $10M; Wednesday signal; rank by 15-session RTH last-minute close return (residual vs IWM has identical order within a session); top eight

R4.sizing: x0.5 when signal-session RTH volume > arithmetic mean of preceding 20 RTH sessions (signal excluded); equality full; missing 21-session history neutral (full)

R5.sizing: independently x0.5 for ret3>0 (signal close / close 3 sessions earlier - 1; zero is not positive) and x0.5 for the same above-mean volume; tiers 8300/4150/2075

baseline_specs.entry: next exchange session after signal; final RTH minute bar (15:59 regular, 12:59 early close) CLOSE; missed if that exact bar is absent
baseline_specs.quantity_original: floor(ticket / fill close) — LEGACY_FILL_CLOSE_QUANTITY, labeled modeling assumption (uses the fill print to size)
baseline_specs.quantity_causal: floor(ticket / last completed bar close before the final minute) — CAUSAL_PREORDER_QUANTITY, separately labeled panel
baseline_specs.exit: H10 = ten exchange sessions after fill (fill = H0); same final-RTH-minute CLOSE; missing observation => UNRESOLVED_LOCAL_MISSING, never backdated; a later print is a diagnostic delayed cover, shown separately
baseline_specs.borrow_proxy: inherited borrow_blocks_short(gap<=-5% and prior DV<$10M) retained and counted as INHERITED_BORROW_PROXY_BLOCK; it is not locate evidence
baseline_specs.actions: the eight issuer-documented reverse splits in reports/cg_arrow003_corporate_actions.json applied as-of; no inferred factors; unknown dividends/loans are null

replay_stages.R0: read-only reproduction of frozen Arrow 003 control results (data/tmp/cg_arrow003/results/{PARENT,R4,R5}_{IS,OOS,ALL}.json) and legacy figures in cg_arrow003_repair_metrics.json; no rescoring of old code
replay_stages.R1: fixed historical decisions: the recorded top-eight per cohort (repaired-ranking order as frozen in Arrow 003 details), recorded features/tickets/quantities; corrected observation statuses and accounting; every intended slot exported
replay_stages.R2: unchanged rules on the locally available complete-as-possible field: recompute eligibility, rank, top eight and features from checked inputs; report membership/feature deltas versus R1; ranking scope labeled RANKING_SCOPE_UNVERIFIED where the copied acquisition ceiling ($50 for 2026-06..08, $80 earlier) truncates the $10-$80 field

source_hierarchy: data/verification/r4r5/v1/validated (new, none acquired in this pass)
data/virgin/bars and data/full/bars canonical one-minute partitions (checked: RTH filter, positive volume, finite OHLC, ordering)
data/virgin/eod national 17:15 reports: SAME-VENDOR reference for corroboration/uncertain liability marks only; never an execution
verification_tests: R1 entry ids and quantities equal Arrow 003 recorded positions
independent oracle: per-trade PnL, cohort subtotals, daily cash-minus-liability equality within 1e-6 internal and cents at report level
every intended slot exported (52 cohorts x 8)
minute-close vs EOD close consistency for every H10 entry/exit where both exist
missing_data_policy: Missing local observation => status UNRESOLVED_LOCAL_MISSING (not a market halt claim); status NOT_PREVIOUSLY_REQUESTED when absent from the ingest manifest, EMPTY_RESPONSE_UNRESOLVED when manifest rows==0, PARTIAL_OR_SPARSE_REVIEW when present but final-minute bar absent; unresolved slots carry null net PnL and are excluded from VERIFIED totals but included in INTENDED counts
horizon_rule: same R2 entry ledger, same shares, exit at Hn final-RTH-minute close; no reinvestment; gate = all R2 H1..H10 exit observations present or documented; IS first, then one OOS batch

cost_scenarios.borrow_clock: calendar days on preceding EOD marked gross / 365

not_in_scope: secondary BRIDGE/S0 replay unless budget remains
